summary: One-frame marker of the transform pipeline (sibling of ls::TranslateChangedOneFrameComponent / ls::RotateChangedOneFrameComponent), added when an entity's scale changes (seen around locked doors/chests, dialogues, level change). Holds one vec3.

fields.name: Scale
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3C795F0 (one-frame default add, TypeIndex<ls::ScaleChangedOneFrameComponent>_OneFrameComponentTypeIdContext): ComponentFrameStorageAllocRaw(.., 0xC, ..) then zeroes +0 (8 bytes) and +8 (4 bytes) - three floats. Live: server samples (1,1,1) and (1.2,1.2,1.2); client samples uniform-looking floats 0..2.15 (e.g. 0.01, 0.6, 0.9) - a per-axis scale.

open_questions: Previous or new scale (default is 0,0,0, not 1,1,1): the writer that fills it with a real value was not found.
raw_check: 32 instances, se-fork/coverage/check.py raw stage, game v4.76.31.656
